review_summary: Upgrade your wiping routine and send toilet paper back to the Stone Age where it belongs. Made with 99% water and plant based ingredients, DUDE Wipes adult flushable butt wipes are infused with aloe, chamomile extract, and vitamin E to gently cleanse the skin and give you a cleaner, more refreshing feeling than dry TP ever could. DUDE Wipes wet wipes are plastic-free, dermatologically tested, hypoallergenic, formulated without dyes, parabens, or alcohol, and are extra large for full coverage - because nobody wants a little wipe after a big burrito. And unlike baby wipes, DUDE Wipes are made with plant sourced fibers that begin to break down once flushed, making them sewer and septic safe. So join this hole revolution and embrace the Best Clean, Pants Down.
